full_name: Stephanie LeMenager | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Stephanie LeMenager is the Barbara and Carlisle Moore Distinguished Professor of English and American Literature and a professor of environmental studies at the University of Oregon. Her research interests begin with the question of what it means to be human in the era of climate change.
